basis: Both endpoints are proposed matching targets, not measured LED qualification. Current extrema, transient/restart envelope, actual pin labeling and optical/temp/bin constraints require agreement before schematic acceptance.
startup_fault_behavior: Disconnected replacement only with verified discharge; IC cannot limit a direct C6-to-LED reconnection impulse. No powered hotplug. All pins mains-referenced.
port_type: Two solder-wire pads at each end; consumer mating/contact barrier not selected.
